stem.text: A metal cylinder is suspended vertically in equilibrium by a cord. The diagram shows the cylinder in four different positions P, Q, R and S.

stem.alt: Metal cylinder hanging from a cord at four positions labelled P, Q, R and S, each cord labelled T with an upward arrow; the cylinder is shown partly and fully submerged in water, with the water surface drawn as a line.

stem.text: Which statement explains the variation of the tension $T$ in the cord?

A.text: At P and at Q, the tension $T$ in the cord is the same because the difference in pressure between the top and bottom of the cylinder is the same.

B.text: At Q, the tension $T$ in the cord is less than at P because, at smaller depth, liquid pressure is smaller.

C.text: At R, the tension $T$ in the cord is less than at P because atmospheric pressure is less than water pressure.

D.text: At S, the tension $T$ in the cord is greater than at P because atmospheric pressure at S exerts no force on the top or bottom of the cylinder.
